rationale: Visible evidence supports the core assertion: CFC-only has macro regret@3 0.044697 and cost 13.833, while LoopCert-family/Pareto contenders improve macro regret@3 to about 0.032-0.033 but have higher cost around 16.5-16.667, so they do not beat CFC-only on mean cost-to-contain. The script evidence states the CE selector gate requires beating CFC-only on both macro_normalized_regret_at3 and mean_cost_to_contain_winner, and the oral-ready gate remains closed for CE-selection/resource-gate reasons. The producer report also says large-heldout evaluation and seed robustness passed, making additional large-eval plumbing less directly supported than selector cost improvement. The 'most important' phrasing is somewhat prioritization-heavy, but the provided evidence reasonably supports selector improvement as the leading next priority.
